\n\n

सीधी उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्शरेखा = √ (दो केंद्रों के बीच की दूरी2 - ( r1  - r2)2

\n\n

सूत्र के अनुसार,

\n\n

D = √ (332 - ( 18  - 15)2.

\n\n

⇒ √ (332 - 32)

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ 6√30

அலமாரியின் குறிக்கப்பட்ட விலை ₹15,750 ஆகும், இது அதன் அடக்க விலையை விட 50% அதிகமாகும். இது 40% தள்ளுபடியில் விற்கப்படுகிறது. இலாபம்/நட்டம் சதவீதம் என்ன?

\n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "இலாபம், 10%"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "நட்டம் , 10%"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "நட்டம் , 20%"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "இலாபம், 20%"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "

Given:

\n\n

The marked price = ₹15,750, which is 50% above its cost price.

\n\n

Discount = 40%.

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

The discount is calculated on market price while profit is calculated on cost price.

\n\n

Calculation: 

\n\n

After discount, the selling price is 15750 × 60/100 = Rs 9450

\n\n

The cost price of article is 15750 × 100/150 = 10500

\n\n

The loss percentage is (10500 - 9450)/ 10500 × 100 = 10%

\n\n

∴ The correct option is 2

\n", "hn": "

दिया गया है:

\n\n

अंकित मूल्य = ₹15,750, जो इसके क्रय मूल्य से 50% अधिक है।

\n\n

छूट = 40%

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

छूट की गणना बाजार मूल्य पर की जाती है जबकि लाभ की गणना क्रय मूल्य पर की जाती है।

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

छूट के बाद, विक्रय मूल्य 15750 × 60/100 = 9450 रुपये है

\n\n

वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य 15750 × 100/150 = 10500 है

\n\n

हानि प्रतिशत है: (10500 - 9450)/10500 × 100 = 10%

\n\n

∴ सही विकल्प 2 है

\n", "te": "

ఇచ్చింది:

\n\n

గుర్తించబడిన ధర = ₹ 15,750, ఇది దాని కొన్న ధర కంటే 50% ఎక్కువ.

\n\n

రాయితీ = 40%.

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

\n\n

రాయితీ గుర్తించబడిన ధరపై లెక్కించబడుతుంది, లాభం కొన్న ధరపై లెక్కించబడుతుంది.

\n\n

గణన: 

\n\n

రాయితీ తరువాత, అమ్మకపు ధర 15750 × 60/100 = రూ.9450

\n\n

వస్తువు యొక్క కొన్న ధర 15750 × 100/150 = 10500

\n\n

నష్టం శాతం (10500 - 9450)/ 10500 × 100 = 10%

\n\n

∴ సరైన ఎంపిక 2

\n", "mr": "

दिले आहे:

\n\n

चिन्हांकित किंमत = ₹15,750, जी त्याच्या खरेदी किमतीच्या 50% पेक्षा जास्त आहे.

\n\n

सवलत = 40%.

\n\n

वापरलेली संकल्पना:

\n\n

सवलत बाजारभावावर मोजली जाते तर नफा खरेदी किमतीवर मोजला जातो.

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

सवलतीनंतर, विक्री किंमत 15750 x 60/100 = 9450 रुपये

\n\n

वस्तूची खरेदी किंमत 15750 x 100/150 = 10500

\n\n

तोट्याची टक्केवारी (10500 - 9450)/ 10500 x 100 = 10%

\n\n

∴ योग्य पर्याय आहे 2

\n", "bn": "

প্রদত্ত:

\n\n

চিহ্নিত মূল্য = 15,750 টাকা, যা তার ক্রয়মূল্যের থেকে 50% বেশি।

\n\n

ছাড় = 40%.

\n\n

ব্যবহৃত ধারণা:

\n\n

ছাড় চিহ্নিত মূল্যের উপর গণনা করা হয় যখন লাভ ক্রয়মূল্যের উপর গণনা করা হয়।

\n\n

গণনা:

\n\n

ছাড়ের পর, বিক্রয় মূল্য হল 15750 × 60/100 = 9450 টাকা

\n\n

পণ্যটির ক্রয়মূল্য হল 15750 × 100/150 = 10500

\n\n

ক্ষতির শতাংশ হল (10500 - 9450)/ 10500 × 100 = 10%

\n\n

∴ সঠিক বিকল্পটি হল 2

\n", "ml": "", "gu": "

આપેલ:

\n\n

ચિહ્નિત કિંમત = ₹15,750, જે તેની કિંમત કરતાં 50% વધારે છે.

\n\n

ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ = 40%.

\n\n

વપરાયેલ ખ્યાલ:

\n\n

ડિસ્કાઉન્ટની ગણતરી બજાર કિંમત પર કરવામાં આવે છે જ્યારે નફો કિંમત કિંમત પર ગણવામાં આવે છે.

\n\n

ગણતરી:

\n\n

ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ પછી, વેચાણ કિંમત છે 15750 x 60/100 = રૂ. 9450

\n\n

લેખની કિંમત છે 15750 x 100/150 = 10500

\n\n

નુકસાનની ટકાવારી છે (10500 - 9450)/ 10500 x 100 = 10%

\n\n

∴ સાચો વિકલ્પ 2 છે

\n", "kn": "", "ta": "

கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

\n\n

குறிக்கப்பட்ட விலை = ₹15,750, இது அதன் அடக்க விலையை விட 50% அதிகம்.

\n\n

தள்ளுபடி = 40%.

\n\n

பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட கருத்து:

\n\n

தள்ளுபடி சந்தை விலையில் கணக்கிடப்படுகிறது, அதே நேரத்தில் இலாபம் அடக்க விலையில் கணக்கிடப்படுகிறது.

\n\n

கணக்கீடு:

\n\n

தள்ளுபடிக்குப் பிறகு, விற்பனை விலை 15750 × 60/100 = ரூ 9450

\n\n

பொருளின் அடக்க விலை 15750 × 100/150 = 10500

\n\n

3 கிண்ணம் மற்றும் 5 தட்டுகளின் விலை ₹1,080 மற்றும் 2 கிண்ணம் மற்றும் 4 தட்டுகளின் விலை ₹840. ஒரு கிண்ணத்தின் விலைக்கும் ஒரு தட்டின் விலைக்கும் உள்ள விகிதத்தைக் கண்டறியவும்.

\n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "1 : 3"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "2 : 3"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "1 : 1"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "1 : 2"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n Shortcut Trick\n

2 Cups + 4 Plates = 840 → 1 Cup + 2 Plates = 420.

\n

Multiply by 3 ⇒ 3 Cups + 6 Plates = 1260.

\n

Difference with (3 Cups + 5 Plates = 1080) ⇒ 1 Plate = 1260 − 1080 = 180.

\n

Cost of 1 Cup = 420 − (2 × 180) = 420 − 360 = 60.

\n

Ratio of Cup to Plate = 60 : 180 = 1 : 3.

\n

∴ The correct answer is 1 ∶ 3.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Cost of 3 cups and 5 plates = ₹1,080

\n

Cost of 2 cups and 4 plates = ₹840

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Simultaneous Linear Equations: a1x + b1y = c1 and a2x + b2y = c2

\n\n

Let the cost of one cup be C and the cost of one plate be P.

\n

⇒ 3C + 5P = 1080 ... (i)

\n

⇒ 2C + 4P = 840 ... (ii)

\n

⇒ From (ii), C + 2P = 420 ⇒ C = 420 − 2P

\n

⇒ Substitute C in (i): 3 × (420 − 2P) + 5P = 1080

\n

⇒ 1260 − 6P + 5P = 1080

\n

⇒ 1260 − P = 1080

\n

⇒ P = 1260 − 1080 = 180

\n

⇒ C = 420 − 2 × 180 = 420 − 360 = 60

\n

⇒ Ratio C : P = 60 : 180

\n

⇒ C : P = 1 : 3

\n

∴ The correct answer is 1 ∶ 3.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Linear Equations in Two Variables

\n

An equation of the form ax + by + c = 0 where a, b, and c are real numbers and a, b ≠ 0.

\n

Ratio and Proportion

\n

A ratio is a comparison of two quantities by division, denoted as a : b or a/b. It has no units if both quantities have the same unit.

\n

Elimination Method

\n

A method of solving simultaneous equations by making the coefficients of one variable equal to eliminate it by addition or subtraction.

\n

(3 कप + 5 प्लेट = 1080) के साथ अंतर ⇒ 1 प्लेट = 1260 − 1080 = 180.

\n

1 कप का मूल्य = 420 − (2 x 180) = 420 − 360 = 60.

\n

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 1 ∶ 3 है।

\n

\n

\n

\n

⇒ P = 1260 − 1080 = 180

\n

⇒ C = 420 − 2 x 180 = 420 − 360 = 60

\n

⇒ अनुपात C : P = 60 : 180

\n

⇒ C : P = 1 : 3

\n

∴ सही उत्तर 1 ∶ 3 है।

\n\n

अतिरिक्त जानकारी

\n

दो चरों वाले रैखिक समीकरण

\n

ax + by + c = 0 के रूप का एक समीकरण जहाँ a, b और c वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं और a, b ≠ 0 हैं।

\n

अनुपात और समानुपात

\n

अनुपात विभाजन द्वारा दो मात्राओं की तुलना है, जिसे a : b या a/b के रूप में दर्शाया जाता है। यदि दोनों मात्राओं की इकाई समान है तो इसकी कोई इकाई नहीं होती है।

\n

विलोपन विधि

\n

जोड़ या घटाव द्वारा इसे समाप्त करने के लिए एक चर के गुणांक को समान बनाकर युगपत समीकरणों को हल करने की एक विधि।

In compound interest,

\n\n

Amount = Principal × (1 + r / 100)n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

\n\n

⇒ 62500× (27/25)2 .

\n\n

⇒ 62500 × 729/625

\n\n

⇒ 729 × 100

\n\n

⇒ Rs. 72900

\n\n

The interest will be 72900 - 62500 = Rs 10400

\n\n

∴ The correct option is 3

Shortcut Trick\n

Total area to paint = Area of 4 walls + Area of ceiling

\n

Total area = 2 × h × (l + b) + (l × b)

\n

Total area = 2 × 3 × (7 + 5) + (7 × 5) = 72 + 35 = 107 m2

\n

Total Cost = 107 × 16 = ₹1,712

\n

∴ The correct answer is ₹1,712.

\n\n

Alternate Method

\n

Given:

\n

Length (l) = 7 m, Breadth (b) = 5 m, Height (h) = 3 m

\n

Rate of whitewashing = ₹16 per m2

\n

Formula Used:

\n

Area of 4 walls (Lateral Surface Area) = 2h(l + b)

\n

Area of ceiling = l × b

\n\n\n\n

Calculations:

\n

⇒ Area of 4 walls = 2 × 3 × (7 + 5) m2

\n

⇒ Area of 4 walls = 6 × 12 = 72 m2

\n

⇒ Area of ceiling = 7 × 5 = 35 m2

\n

⇒ Total area to be whitewashed = 72 + 35 = 107 m2

\n

⇒ Total Cost = Total Area × Rate per m2

\n

⇒ Total Cost = 107 × 16 = 1712

\n

∴ The correct answer is ₹1,712.

\n\n

Additional Information

\n

Total Surface Area of a Cuboid

\n

Includes the area of all 6 rectangular faces: 2(lb + bh + hl).

\n\n

Lateral Surface Area (Area of 4 walls)

\n

Excludes the top (ceiling) and bottom (floor) faces: 2h(l + b).

\n\n

Length of Longest Diagonal

\n

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboidal room is its main diagonal: √(l2 + b2 + h2).

Given:

\n\n

The simple interest = ₹11,220, rate of interest = \\(16 \\frac{1}{2} \\%\\) per annum, time = 8 years and 3 months 

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Simple Interest (SI) = [Principal (P) ×  Rate of interest (R)  × Time(T)] /100

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

Amount = Principal + Interest

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

8 years 3 months = 33/4 yr

\n\n

Let the sum be P,

\n\n

⇒ 11220= [P × 33 ×33]/(100 × 2 × 4)

\n\n

⇒ P = 11220 × 100 × 2 × 4 /  33 ×33

\n\n

= Rs 8,242

\n\n

∴ The correct option is 4

साधारण ब्याज = ₹11,220, ब्याज दर = \\(16 \\frac{1}{2} \\%\\) प्रति वर्ष, समय = 8 वर्ष और 3 माह

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

\n\n

प्रयुक्त संकल्पना:

\n\n

मिश्रधन = मूलधन + ब्याजఇచ్చింది:

\n\n

బారు వడ్డీ = ₹ 11,220, వడ్డీ రేటు = \\(16 \\frac{1}{2} \\%\\) సంవత్సరానికి, సమయం = 8 సంవత్సరాల 3 నెలలు 

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

\n\n

బారు వడ్డీ (SI) = [అసలు (P) × వడ్డీ రేటు (R) × సమయం(T)] /100

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

\n\n

మొత్తం = అసలు + వడ్డీ

\n\n

గణన:

\n\n

8 సంవత్సరాల 3 నెలలు = 33/4 సంవత్సరాలు

\n\n

మొత్తంని  P గా అనుకుందాం,

\n\n

⇒ 11220= [P × 33 ×33]/(100 × 2 × 4)

\n\n

⇒ P = 11220 × 100 × 2 × 4 /  33 ×33

\n\n

= రూ 8,242

\n\n

∴ సరైన ఎంపిక 4

वापरलेली संकल्पना:

\n\n

रक्कम = मुद्दल + व्याज

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

⇒ 11220= [P × 33 ×33]/(100 × 2 × 4)

\n\n

⇒ P = 11220 × 100 × 2 × 4 / 33 × 33

= 8,242 रुपये

\n\n

∴ पर्याय 4 योग्य आहे.

          The correct answer is: Some urgent help was needed by his bro", "hn": "", "te": "", "mr": "", "bn": "", "ml": "", "gu": "", "kn": "", "ta": "", "or": "", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "", "sd": "", "ur": "", "sat": "", "mai": "", "brx": "", "doi": "", "sa": "", "grt": "", "kha": "", "lus": "", "bo": "", "trp": ""}, "tags": ["Vocabulary"], "concept": "Antonym", "confidence": "high"}, {"qid": "64e5e1943bb078f6459955e0", "qs_no": 10, "pos_marks": 2.0, "neg_marks": 0.5, "type": "mcq", "langs": {"en": {"value": "

          Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

          \n\n

          His brother needed some urgent help at that moment.

          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Some urgent help was needed by his brother at that moment."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Urgent help was needed by his brother at that moment."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Some urgent help is needed by his brother at that moment."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Some urgent help was needed by his brother at this moment."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

          The correct answer is: Some urgent help was needed by his brother at that moment.

          \n\n

          Key Points

          \n\n
            \n\t
          • In the active voice, the subject performs the action.
            • \n\t
          • In this case, "His brother" is the subject, and "needed" is the action.
            • \n\t
          • Active structure: Subject + Verb + Object\n\t
              \n\t\t
            • Example: The chef prepared a delicious meal for the guests.
              • \n\t
            \n\t
            • \n\t
          • In the passive voice, the focus shifts from the doer of the action to the receiver of the action.
            • \n\t
          • Passive structure: Object (Receiver of the action) + to be verb + Past participle of the verb + Subject (Agent)\n\t
              \n\t\t
            • Example: A delicious meal was prepared for the guests by the chef.
              • \n\t
            \n\t
            • \n\t
          • Here, for the given sentence "Some urgent help" becomes the subject, and the verb is expressed in the past participle form, which is "was needed."
            • \n\t
          • The agent (the doer of the action) is introduced with "by his brother."
            • \n
          \n\n

          Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
